mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future S&P 500 cash flows and generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls by at least 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises by at least 50k in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals an impending slowdown in housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1100.0 during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profit growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 108.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales and housing starts signals a broad-based slowdown in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS falls by at least 2% and HOUST falls by at least 1% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to long-term equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 3.5% for two consecutive months.
